instruction: Design a system that combines the 3-to-8 decoder and 4-bit binary counter modules from the given prompts. The decoder should have active-high outputs and an enable input, while the counter should have a synchronous reset input and a clock input. Additionally, the system should include an additional functional module that takes in the outputs of both the decoder and counter, adds them, and stores the result in an 8-bit register. The system should output the value of the register.
